interpretation.candidate: graph cone plus eager display may preserve eager interleaving; delayed display may instead defer waiting onto next cone/FIFO; neither benefit is measured
interpretation.replica: xpu:2 environment is not an instantiated stream decode replica; changing placement requires new residence admission and cross-card exact-output qualification
interpretation.snapshot_timing_limit: inspector seconds exclude CandidateSafety pre-inspect synchronization; nondual memory part includes the second synchronization and memory readings; cannot attribute all inspector time to synchronization
interpretation.supported: dg1 predecessor display completion coincides with successor upsampler return; delay occurs before stage-B conditioning, not in its snapshots or precompute wait
interpretation.unproven: queue/CCS-level cause and exact blocking operation require later device evidence

methodology.execution: standard library, CPU only, explicit regular-file reads; no runtime import
methodology.live_file_limits: manifest and client.log are captured read-only; may grow after this read
methodology.period_definition: receipt submit[i+1] minus submit[i], i=10..35, seconds
methodology.qualification: each per-chunk equality is observed; CPU analysis is not new qualification
methodology.summary: median/min/max, no interpolation; paired sample by stream sequence
methodology.timestamp_limits: host wall timestamps identify boundaries, not device queue submissions
